sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Immunofluorescence in H4 cells showed the HA-tagged construct traffics to punctate cytoplasmic structures co-localizing with transferrin receptor (sorting/recycling endosomes), Rab7 (maturing endosomes), and Lamp-1 (late endosomes/lysosomes), confirming surface trafficking and internalization. Enzymatic function of BACE1 was NOT MEASURED directly for the tagged construct.
sites.rationale: L1 reports a single HA tag inserted 'after the propeptide cleavage site' of full-length, membrane-anchored BACE1. UniProt P56817 annotates the propeptide as residues 22-45 (furin cleavage at RLPR|E), placing the junction at R45|E46; both residues lie within the extracellular domain (22-456), 412 residues from the TM boundary. L2 (same paper, same construct) confirms surface trafficking by immunofluorescence co-localization with endosomal/lysosomal markers. The position is classified topology_derived because the paper names the biological landmark (propeptide cleavage site) rather than an explicit residue number, and the junction is computed from the UniProt propeptide annotation. Full-length BACE1 construct with a single HA tag inserted after the propeptide cleavage site (after R45, the last residue of the UniProt-annotated propeptide 22-45), with a stop codon after K501, expressed in human neuroglioma H4 cells. The propeptide cleavage junction (R45|E46) is the sole specific biological landmark named; the residue number 45 is computed from UniProt P56817 annotation of the propeptide span 22-45.

sources.claim: A single HA tag was inserted after the propeptide cleavage site and a stop codon was introduced after residue K501 to stop the expression of GFP using site-directed mutagenesis (Stratagene, La Jolla, CA).

literature_notes: L1/L2 (PMC3374752): HA tag after propeptide cleavage site — the sole qualifying extracellular surface tag site. Position computed as insert_after_residue=45 from UniProt P56817 propeptide annotation (22-45); residue_before=R, residue_after=E. L2 confirms surface trafficking of the same construct. L3/L4 (PMC6938271): BACE1FL-SBP-EGFP — full-length construct with SBP+EGFP fused at the C-terminus (residue 501), which is intracellular (478-501); placed in other_positions as intracellular. L5 (PMC2793532): myc-tagged BACE1 — no residue or loop named, tag position entirely unstated; dropped per rules (tag position unstated, cannot pin insert_after_residue). L6 (PMC9576659): BACE1-VC (Venus C-terminal fragment 155-238) — C-terminal fusion, intracellular; placed in other_positions as intracellular.

literature_other_positions.note: Full-length BACE1 fused with SBP and EGFP at the C-terminus (K501); the C-terminus is intracellular (residues 478-501), so this is not a surface tag site.
BACE1 fused to Venus C-terminal fragment (residues 155-238) at the C-terminus (K501); intracellular terminus, not a surface tag site.
